import CertifiedGaps.ChainCheck


/-!
# The 240 coupling intervals of the ladder theorem: chain certificates

Generated by `gen_lean_ladder_intervals.py`. Each entry is an interval `[la, lb]` of the coupling `λ`, the
seed inverse temperature `β₀` and a chain certificate whose first entries are upper bounds on the seed
defects of that interval (from the ball-arithmetic certificates, padded upward). The kernel checks every
certificate and that the intervals tile `[0, 6]`. `gap_on_interval` is upstream's abstract theorem applied
to an interval: for ANY family of spectra satisfying the spatial moment bounds and the two seed purities,
the gap on every even ring `L ≥ 2` exceeds `log r / β₀`. That the ladder's spectra satisfy those
hypotheses is the content of Lemmas 1 to 4 of the note; it is not proved here.
-/

theorem intervals_length : intervals.length = 240 := by decide +kernel

theorem intervals_valid : ∀ I ∈ intervals, I.cert.Valid := by decide +kernel

theorem intervals_β₀_pos : ∀ I ∈ intervals, 0 < I.β₀ := by decide +kernel

/-- The intervals tile `[0, 6]`: the first starts at `0`, each ends where the next starts, the last ends at `6`. -/
theorem intervals_tile : (intervals.head?.map (·.la) = some 0) ∧ (intervals.getLast?.map (·.lb) = some 6) ∧
    (List.zipWith (fun I J ↦ decide (I.lb = J.la ∧ I.la < I.lb)) intervals intervals.tail).all id = true := by
  decide +kernel

/-- The smallest certified rate over all intervals, as a lower bound on `log r / β₀`, is recorded per entry above. -/
theorem gap_on_interval {ι : ℕ → Type*} [∀ L, Fintype (ι L)] [∀ L, Nonempty (ι L)]
    (E : (L : ℕ) → ι L → ℝ) (hZ : HasSpatialMomentBounds E 2) {I : Interval} (hI : I ∈ intervals)
    (hs : 1 - (I.cert.sAt 0 : ℝ) ≤ spatialPurity E 2 I.β₀)
    (ht : 1 - (I.cert.tAt 0 : ℝ) ≤ thermalPurity E (2 * 2) I.β₀) {L : ℕ} (hL : 2 ≤ L) (hLe : Even L) :
    GapGT (E L) (log (I.cert.r : ℝ) / I.β₀) :=
  gapGT_of_chainCertificate E (by norm_num) (by decide) (by exact_mod_cast intervals_β₀_pos I hI) hZ
    I.cert (intervals_valid I hI) hs ht hL hLe

end GaugeGaps.Ladder
